svg.title: Traditional OCR, specialized document models, and general VLMs cover progressively broader tasks, but all three need benchmarking on the same labeled workload.
svg.desc: Three OCR model families trade task breadth for deployment cost: traditional engines handle clean print on local CPU or self-hosted deployment; specialized document models add layout, tables, and formulas on self-hosted GPU or API; general VLMs add extraction, visual question answering, and reasoning as a hosted API or open weights. Deployment mode varies by specific product, so benchmark all three against the same labeled workload before choosing.
